    s = title.lower()
    s = s.replace('&', ' and ')
    s = ''.join(c for c in s if ('a' <= c <= 'z') or ('0' <= c <= '9') or c == ' ' or c == '-')
    import re
    s = re.sub(r'[ -]+', '-', s)
    s = s.strip('-')
    if len(s) > 40:
        s = s[:40].rstrip('-')
